Licensing model: All prices are list and exclude applicable taxes. Multi-year prepayment attracts a further 5% discount. Pricing is held flat for the committed term with uplift at renewal capped at CPI or 4% whichever is lower.
Payment terms are net 30 from invoice date. Annual invoicing is standard; quarterly invoicing is available on the Enterprise plan at no surcharge.
There is no charge for read-only Auditor seats on the Enterprise plan up to 10% of the paid seat count.
